concerns.text: The spec contains NO user stories / user journeys section at all. The template mandates 'User Scenarios & Testing (mandatory)' with prioritized, independently testable stories. Without a story list, none of the FR-001..FR-010 or SC-001..SC-005 can be traced to a stated goal or user value — every FR/SC is effectively an orphan relative to the story layer, and there is no way to verify the pipeline delivers an MVP slice.

The Overview states a single goal ('analyze the relationship between OSM derived urban features and LST to quantify UHI effects') but no decomposition into prioritized goals/stories. E.g., is exploratory analysis (FR-004) a P1 deliverable or a stepping stone? Is the proxy-validity analysis (FR-010, Constitution Principle VII) a first-class user-facing outcome or internal QA? Priorities cannot be inferred, so downstream implementers cannot order work or define an MVP.

The fallback block references plan-level task IDs (T026a, T026b, T027–T029) and output paths (data/results/metrics.csv) but names no user story or goal it serves. Once stories are added, re-anchor this (and all FRs/SCs) to the story whose scope they cover, e.g. 'serves the model-fitting story' or an inline 'See US-N'.
